text:
The gate agent noted a question about supply orders after reading your thoughts, and I am writing on behalf of the Companion Animal Travel Desk to address your concern with care and clarity. You explained that the handling of your companion animal booking felt disorganised, that communication was slower than expected, and that you were left uncertain about whether the necessary arrangements were secure.

I regret that your experience fell short of the standard Aurelia Skyways aims to provide. Our desk is expected to communicate promptly and respectfully, especially when a traveler has entrusted us with the well-being of a companion animal. I have reviewed the service record and confirmed that the relevant notes were entered into the desk ledger in the usual manner. Where a change to the reservation was needed, the adjustment should have been explained more clearly, and I understand how frustrating it is when that does not happen.

Please be assured that dependable companion travel remains a priority for us. When a concern is raised, we expect the first response to be calm, accurate, and supportive. We also remind staff that every update affecting an animal's travel plan must be documented carefully so that the next colleague can continue the service without confusion. This is part of the routine work that keeps our operations steady and helps prevent avoidable distress for travelers and their pets.

While I cannot undo the inconvenience you experienced, I can confirm that your complaint has been noted for follow-up within the desk team. Feedback of this kind is taken seriously because it helps us strengthen the service we provide and improve consistency across shifts. If you travel with us again, we will do our best to ensure that the process is handled with greater attention and clearer communication from the outset.

Thank you for bringing this matter to our attention and for giving us the opportunity to respond. We value the trust placed in Aurelia Skyways and remain committed to better service for you and your companion animal.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
